feeds.title: Breast Cancer Support Blog
feeds.description: Breast Cancer Support Aotearoa has been helping people diagnosed with breast cancer since the 1980s. They are the only national organization in New Zealand with a peer support focus for those diagnosed with breast cancer and are recognized by medical providers of breast cancer services as a reputable source of structured peer support. Readers can find inspirational posts on the blog, battling against cancer takes a toll on the body, and the blog will help you keep your chin up.

feeds.title: Breast Cancer Cure Blog
feeds.description: Breast Cancer Cure is registered with the Charities Commission. Since its establishment, it has funded many significant research projects in New Zealand. Its work continues to grow in importance, especially as breast cancer in New Zealand grows at epidemic proportions. Check out the blog to learn about the ongoing research and other advancements made in the treatment of cancer.

feeds.title: Gut Cancer Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Gut Cancer Foundation is a team of committed professionals who are passionate about making a positive change and creating an everlasting impact for all New Zealanders affected by gut cancers, dedicating their professional expertise and personal time to help achieve their mission. Their mission is to improve and save the lives of all New Zealanders affected by gut cancers. The blog is dedicated to spreading awareness about gut cancer and other forms of cancer as well.

feeds.title: Bowel Cancer NZ Blog
feeds.description: Bowel Cancer NZ is a nationwide, patient-focused charity dedicated to reducing the impact of bowel cancer in their communities through awareness, education, advocacy, research, and support. Their goal is to lead the world with solutions to reduce New Zealand's bowel cancer statistics and free future generations from the impact of bowel cancer. Read survivor stories on the blog.

feeds.title: NZ Skin Health Blog
feeds.description: NZ Skin Health is a skin cancer clinic where they map your moles, diagnose, monitor, and can be fully treated in comfort by a team of clinicians. Their focus is your comfort. Find skin health advice, insights, tips, and news from the team, sun sense advice, treatments and patients' common fears, clinic news updates, and more.

feeds.title: The Gift Marie Henderson Blog
feeds.description: Marie Henderson lives with her husband in Palmerston North, New Zealand, and has enjoyed a long and varied career as a Registered Nurse. She was diagnosed with cancer in September 2021. You might find it interesting to share her journey at a slightly deeper level in which she discusses her underlying motivations, life-changing lessons, and potentially helpful strategies and resources that you may like to try yourself or share with a friend.

feeds.title: Riders Against Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Riders Against Cancer is a group of motorbike riders who like to hit the road and ride as a group. They ride weekly when they can, and head to destinations where they can support small businesses. The range of bikes, riders, and experience is diverse, which leads to some interesting conversations and many new friendships. They ride to raise funds for cancer-related causes. They share stories and spread awareness through their blog.
